name: Bass River Golf Course
cardNote: The official 2026 downloadable scorecard and hole tour provide the pars, yardages and handicaps. The course page’s introductory sentence incorrectly calls hole 9 a 169-yard par 3; its detailed hole 9 tour and scorecard show 355 yards and par 4, while hole 15 is the 169-yard par 3. The published Red row is omitted because its displayed hole values do not reconcile to its printed total. All 18 numbered routes lie inside the Bass River boundary. Six raw OSM par tags conflict with the official card and are preserved with explicit audit corrections. Retrieved October 28, 2026.
